item.title: How Do You Feel About the Risks of Youth Football?

item.title: How Many N.F.L. Players Will Have C.T.E.?
item.description: New research finds that at least one in four N.F.L. players who died in a six-year period had C.T.E., a degenerative brain disease caused by repeated impacts to the head. Our reporter John Branch unpacks the data and its implications for the sport.
item.dc:creator: John Branch, Christina Shaman, James Surdam, Lauren Pruitt and Christopher Whitworth

item.title: She Was Absolved of a Heinous Crime. Why Won’t They Leave Her Alone?

item.media:description: “Obtaining a visa in order to seek asylum is fraud — which is grounds for visa revocation,” Tommy Pigott, a State Department spokesman, said in a statement.
